front.transcription:

To set it up, separate the City cards matching cities with a Control Center sticker from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 1 of them facedown into the Operations area.

Then, shuffle the other cards back into the Player deck without looking at them.

Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the unknown City card.
